description: This file contains implementation of triangular matrix operations (tril and triu) for tensors, including meta functions, computational kernels, and backward functions, specific to the ATen library in PyTorch.

classes.name: UpperTriangle
classes.description: Struct representing the upper triangle (triu) operation with static members for operation name and upper flag.

classes.name: LowerTriangle
classes.description: Struct representing the lower triangle (tril) operation with static members for operation name and upper flag.

methods.name: compute_triu_tril
methods.description: Template function to compute either triu or tril based on the Triangle struct, dispatching to the appropriate implementation.

methods.name: apply_triu_tril
methods.description: Template function applying the triu or tril operation to tensors, handling batching and strides.

methods.name: apply_triu_tril_single
methods.description: Per-element kernel applying the triu or tril mask to a single batch.
